Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Aditi - 11 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Anita - 35 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Nitin - 38 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
5. Vimla - 63 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Aditi and Anita stand near him.]

Anita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Kunal searches for his lost ball.]

Kunal: "Yes, of course."

[Kunal folds his hands and prays.]

Aditi (excited): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Aditi draws a rangoli at the door.]

Aditi: "Show me too!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Kunal: "What next?"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Anita: "How beautiful!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Kunal: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
